svg.title: MT8395 LPDDR4X — exact core input, no accepted routes
svg.desc: Diagnostic input snapshot. Every dashed line is an unrouted connectivity request, not copper. All 1446 pads remain obstacles.

g.text: UNROUTED INPUT — NOT A COMPLETED PCB
MT8395AV/ZA + two LPDDR4X packages · 138 signal requests
Exact core SRJ · 1,446 circular pad obstacles · 8 layers · via-in-pad disabled · no input normalization
Inset: EMI1 byte zero · 11 unrouted requests
Byte skew ≤0.50 mm · DQS skew ≤0.10 mm
Dashed lines are airwires. No routed copper is shown.
Research fixture only: power circuitry, reference planes and electrical qualification are absent.
